functions.name: AppendRune
functions.summary: AppendRune appends the UTF-8 encoding of r to the end of p and returns the extended buffer. If the rune is out of range, it appends the encoding of [RuneError].

functions.name: DecodeLastRune
functions.summary: DecodeLastRune unpacks the last UTF-8 encoding in p and returns the rune and its width in bytes. If p is empty it returns ([RuneError], 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

functions.name: DecodeLastRuneInString
functions.summary: DecodeLastRuneInString is like [DecodeLastRune] but its input is a string. If s is empty it returns ([RuneError], 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

functions.name: DecodeRune
functions.summary: DecodeRune unpacks the first UTF-8 encoding in p and returns the rune and its width in bytes. If p is empty it returns ([RuneError], 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

functions.name: DecodeRuneInString

functions.name: EncodeRune
functions.summary: EncodeRune writes into p (which must be large enough) the UTF-8 encoding of the rune. If the rune is out of range, it writes the encoding of [RuneError]. It returns the number of bytes written.

lines: pkg unicode/utf8, func EncodeRune([]uint8, int32) int

functions.name: FullRune
functions.summary: FullRune reports whether the bytes in p begin with a full UTF-8 encoding of a rune. An invalid encoding is considered a full Rune since it will convert as a width-1 error rune.

functions.name: FullRuneInString
functions.summary: FullRuneInString is like FullRune but its input is a string.

functions.name: RuneCount
functions.summary: RuneCount returns the number of runes in p. Erroneous and short encodings are treated as single runes of width 1 byte.

functions.name: RuneCountInString
functions.summary: RuneCountInString is like [RuneCount] but its input is a string.

functions.name: RuneLen
functions.summary: RuneLen returns the number of bytes in the UTF-8 encoding of the rune. It returns -1 if the rune is not a valid value to encode in UTF-8.

functions.name: RuneStart
functions.summary: RuneStart reports whether the byte could be the first byte of an encoded, possibly invalid rune. Second and subsequent bytes always have the top two bits set to 10.
functions.signature: func RuneStart(b byte) bool { return b&0xC0 != 0x80 }

lines: func RuneStart(b byte) bool { return b&0xC0 != 0x80 }

functions.name: Valid
functions.summary: Valid reports whether p consists entirely of valid UTF-8-encoded runes.

functions.name: ValidRune
functions.summary: ValidRune reports whether r can be legally encoded as UTF-8. Code points that are out of range or a surrogate half are illegal.

functions.name: ValidString
functions.summary: ValidString reports whether s consists entirely of valid UTF-8-encoded runes.
